items.lede: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion as part of a funding round that hasn't closed yet but is expected to in the coming weeks.
items.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation

items.lede: OpenAI is now valued at $1.25 trillion in a new round of funding that has raised another $11 billion, according to Bloomberg. That would make it one of the world's most valuable companies, not long after raising $122 billion from investors in March at a valuation of $852 billion. Echoing FT and Wall Street Journal […]
items.title: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO
